worldcombat.skill.fellstinger.summary: A short, precise sting; felling the target with it sharply raises the user's Attack.
worldcombat.skill.fellstinger.descriptio: Lunges in for a short sting: %1$s physical damage; sting range %2$s blocks, %3$s blocks per tick, collision radius %4$s blocks. Knocking the target out with this blow raises the user's Attack by %5$s stages.
